statement: The entire local first-degree intrinsic-to-joint map and kernel, the complete inertia-fixed horizontal obstruction and fibres, and the actual filled elliptic class-two quotient with an evaluated free wild obstruction for all intrinsic inputs.
manuscript_passages: Section51.16, folios733v–736v, scans172–178, formulas371–379; Part E(c),(d), follow-up(4)
notes: The onto map H1(Q3,V) to H1(Q3,J1) has source Z3^15 x C3^3, target Z3^5 x C3, and kernel Z3^10 x C3^3. Every inverse includes the finite carry; the zero map on source torsion proves that no Z3-linear section exists.
The literal coefficient kernel is a saturated rank-seven lattice with saved arithmetic matrices, horizontal factor Z3^4 x C3^3 and relative factor Z3^6.

On all abelian preimages retaining the B0 inertia coordinate, the full class-two obstruction has image C3^3 and three displayed congruences. Its zero locus is Z3^4; every joint image point has fibre Z3^48 x C3^9 x C9^5 in this entire locus.
Every particular central correction is a verified rational matrix over Z_(3). The actual joint normalization, fixed geometric alignment and all nonlinear central corrections are retained.

The actual open-immersion quotient fills exactly eight cusps. The rational swap is proved to be [-1]; its coherent tangent transport squares to one and commutes with arithmetic. The actual central basis change and its inverse eliminate the cross row through a proved equivariant morphism.

The filled quotient has exact free obstruction -7t(U1+21t/2), with two branches t=0 and U1=-21t/2. Every point has full class-two fibre Z3^2, with literal gauge and inverse coordinates. This equals the free intrinsic obstruction by the actual central-extension square.
The fifteen finite intrinsic obstruction coordinates for general relative inputs remain to be evaluated. The complete intrinsic class-two image outside the evaluated horizontal locus is not asserted.

Root read the complete proof and program, independently reopened SGA1 XII 5.1 and 5.2 with their proofs, and reran from copied source and all five hash-checked inputs. Complete stdout and JSON are byte-identical; no fields are omitted.
